turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale, and I'm not here to be polite. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided that, and why didn't anyone call me first?
"Thanks for coming in." I'd have come in without the invitation. You haven't answered me: who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
The file was created at 11:31 PM and the first 612 words appeared at 11:52 PM.

Which night, Hale? And what is the document that shows it, because I can't check a time you've just said out loud. I'm writing down 11:31 and 11:52, and I still don't have an answer on who decided the zero.
Crossing out 612, writing 512. A number that changes while I'm sitting here is exactly why I want paper. Put the document in front of me, with a date on it, or this is just you talking.
How many different numbers have I given you, and how many minutes was the gap?
You're asking me to do your arithmetic now? That's your evidence, Hale, not mine to total up. Show me the document, with the date on it.
